_: WHAT TO ASK FOR IN 3D. The PROSE is never here: `look` lives in tools/art/bodies.json and is the same description the pixel body was generated from, so a body cannot come back as two different characters. What IS here is what only 3D has — how tall the thing stands in metres, and how many triangles it may spend.
_defaults: Applied to every entry unless it says otherwise. lowpoly because the recommendation is low-poly with strong silhouettes; remove_lighting because a baked highlight double-shades under real lights; origin_at bottom because the renderer pins a body at its FOOT; a-pose because rigging wants a rest pose.
_height: Metres, and it is the ONE number that has to agree with the game: a tile is 1 metre, so a hero at 1.8 stands the height the sim already keeps him at.
